title: Gate Decisions
description: Query strings below are plain-English-adjacent pseudo-SQL, not copy-paste-ready syntax for any specific Grafana datasource plugin — no real backend/datasource is wired up in this build. Source: obs.v1 gate.decision events in ~/.claude/metrics/events/*.ndjson. As built in Phase 1 this was emitted by two real gates: the keyword-scored UserPromptSubmit PLAN gate (attrs.gate = "workorder"; attrs.action either "silent" or "inject", plus an optional numeric attrs.score) and payload/hooks/read-guard.sh (attrs.gate = "read-guard"; attrs.action "inject", "silent", or "deny"). The PLAN gate's script has since been removed — no keyword-scored backstop replaces it, see SKILL.md's "PLAN is judgment, not a gate" — so payload/hooks/read-guard.sh is currently the only gate emitting this event; a historical shard may still carry attrs.gate = "workorder" rows. Charts attrs.gate x attrs.action.

panels.title: Decision counts by gate x action
panels.description: Source: obs.v1 gate.decision events' attrs.gate and attrs.action, cross-tabulated.

targets.query: SELECT attrs.gate, attrs.action, count(*) FROM obs_events WHERE event = 'gate.decision' GROUP BY attrs.gate, attrs.action

panels.title: Action distribution, all gates
panels.description: Source: obs.v1 gate.decision events' attrs.action, summed across both gates.

targets.query: SELECT attrs.action, count(*) FROM obs_events WHERE event = 'gate.decision' GROUP BY attrs.action
